name: ruapc
description: ruapc is part of the BOP-style benchmark family focused on evaluating object pose estimation methods. It measures algorithms' ability to detect and estimate 6DoF object poses in challenging scenes (occlusion, clutter, variable lighting) using RGB/RGB-D inputs. The benchmark is intended to assess robustness and accuracy of pose estimators for downstream robotic and AR/vision applications.
reputation: Part of the BOP benchmark suite and recognized in the 6D pose-estimation community, with moderate adoption among specialized vision/robotics researchers.
